industry.why: Overweight, carried unchanged and better supported. Component 1 regime, 23-Oct-26 (risk-off confirmed and broadening: the discount-rate squeeze now a positioning wash-out in the artificial intelligence complex with credit leading it, bonds rallied as a hedge for the first time this cycle while the Fed still hikes in December, the US 10-year near 5.10%, Brent $111, French sovereign stress spilling into Italy, European defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows and breadth in the bottom fifth of three years; sources present 2026-W43): two houses now name staples as the place to be, Jefferies' desk (17 Oct) favouring 'pricing-power defensives such as staples and utilities' as energy inflation seeps into core goods and Danske (18 Oct) calling them 'not a bad place to hide'; energy, utilities and staples led the week and European defensives beat cyclicals by 4.7 points over four weeks (37-breadth-and-defensives.md). Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-23 against 2026-08-21, not week on week: C now, D prior, so the market has started to pay. Not Double Overweight: the multiples that make staples defensive derate with a 5.10% ten-year, and a defensive destination four weeks into a rotation is a crowded one. The sector rows carry B on Beverages, Tobacco, Household products, Food retail and Food production. Moves to A if defensives lead for a second month with the industry's relative strength at B or better.

sector.why: Overweight, carried, on the special topic 'The UK Budget of 28-Oct-26': demand is defensive and the statutory pay floor rises 3.9% in April 2027 against 4.1% in April 2026, a small cost relief, with food tariffs cut; the market disagreed on the day (Sainsbury minus 2.5%, Kingfisher minus 2.6%). Component 1 regime, 30-Oct-26 (risk-off beneath a steady index, led now by credit and the cost of debt rather than by the artificial intelligence wash-out alone: the US ten-year above 5% after a hawkish Fed hold with two dissents for a hike, Goldman Sachs' Risk Appetite Indicator at its lowest since April 2025, euro investment-grade and high-yield yields up 30 and 90 basis points since September, Brent near $115, the French premium a record 150 basis points, Europe rotating to quality, defensives and non-AI growth, the STOXX Europe 600 1.7% from its high with breadth recovering from the bottom fifth of three years and defensives leading cyclicals at four weeks and three months; sources present 2026-W44): inflation sticky with energy pass-through is the regime that pays discount food retail (Danske Bank's call of 18 October stands). Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-30 against 2026-08-28, not week on week: C now, C prior. Three Pool names (Kesko, Distribuidora Internacional de Alimentacion, Greggs at the Bench cut). Not Double Overweight on one house and a Budget; counter-case: thin margins under cost inflation and a UK consumer with 2027 growth at 1.0%. To A if a second house names food retail or a European consumer reading arrives falling with volumes holding.

geography.why: Neutral, carried. No source spoke to Spain this week (a source pack is present, 2026-W43, and it carried nothing country-specific here), relative strength is not graded by country, and Richard's view is G10 and Europe-wide with no country line. An absence is an absence; no tilt.
